real_back_flavor: Skulls and bones decorate the walls of this wide hallway in a macabre fashion.
real_back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter Catacombs, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
real_text: [action]: Test [intellect] (3) to read an ancient sign. If you succeed, look at the revealed side of any Catacombs location in play. (Group limit once per game.) Forced - When Candlelit Tunnels is revealed: Put the top 2 Catacombs in the Catacombs deck into play to the left and right of Candlelit Tunnels.
